SELECT O.RNUM, O.STORE_ORDER_NO, O.STORE_NO, O.STORE_ORDER_DATE, O.FILE_GROUP_NO, O.BILL_NO , O.STORE_ORDER_STATUS, O.STORE_ORDER_SUM, O.STORE_ORDER_TITLE, O.STORE_NM , O.FILE_GROUP_NM, O.FILE_REGDATE, O.FILE_GROUP_TY, O.FILE_NO, O.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME , O.FILE_SAVE_NAME, O.FILE_EXT, O.FILE_SIZE, O.FILE_SAVE_LOCATE, O.FILE_MIME , O.FILE_FANCYSIZE, O.FILE_SAVE_DATE, O.FILE_DOWNCOUNT FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY STORE_ORDER_NO DESC) AS RNUM , SO.STORE_ORDER_NO, SO.STORE_NO, SO.STORE_ORDER_DATE, SO.FILE_GROUP_NO, SO.BILL_NO , SO.STORE_ORDER_STATUS, SO.STORE_ORDER_SUM, SO.STORE_ORDER_TITLE , S.STORE_NM , FG.FILE_GROUP_NM, FG.FILE_REGDATE, FG.FILE_GROUP_TY , FD.FILE_NO, FD.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, FD.FILE_SAVE_NAME, FD.FILE_EXT , FD.FILE_SIZE, FD.FILE_SAVE_LOCATE, FD.FILE_MIME, FD.FILE_FANCYSIZE , FD.FILE_SAVE_DATE, FD.FILE_DOWNCOUNT FROM STORE_ORDER SO LEFT JOIN STORE S ON SO.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN BILL B ON SO.BILL_NO = B.BILL_NO LEFT JOIN FILE_GROUP FG ON SO.FILE_GROUP_NO = FG.FILE_GROUP_NO LEFT JOIN FILE_DETAIL FD ON FG.FILE_GROUP_NO = FD.FILE_GROUP_NO WHERE 1 = 1 AND SO.STORE_NO = #{storeNo} ) O WHERE O.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10-1) AND (#{currentPage} *10)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STORE_ORDER WHERE 1 = 1 AND STORE_NO = #{storeNo}
